name: PR specialist
summary: Gets a business talked about in the press, on podcasts and at events, and helps it respond well when things go wrong. Writes releases, pitches and statements.

changelog.note: First release: newsworthiness, press releases, pitching to an approved media list, embargoes and exclusives, listed-company disclosure limits, awards, talks, podcasts and music press kits, crisis basics from CDC CERC with breach and recall duties, outcome-based measurement, and 25 checked sources.
